title: Create isolated Gemini context service
acceptance: Verify model availability; server-only key, compressed frame, separate queue, 8 s starting deadline. Preserve the restricted uncertain-object Gemini service for optional scene descriptions in explicitly selected crossing scenarios. Do not turn its current object-list output into signal classification or stopped/yielding-traffic decisions. Preserve consent, independent queue, cancellation and original-age limits; no production wire change in this amendment.
evidence: backend/context/: opt-in paired-session context service with server-only key, bounded JPEG reencoding, one active child plus one pending slot, eight-second server deadline, cooldown and cancellation/revocation suppression.

23 context tests passed with generated JPEG/provider fixtures, including real hung-child termination. Backend regression: 128 tests ran, nine optional/environment-specific skips; remaining tests passed. Root suite and publishing checks recorded in handoff.

2026-10-17: real gemini-3.1-flash-lite metadata plus structured-image generation verified within the eight-second probe using a generated neutral JPEG. No real scene or credentials retained. No deployed context, real-device speech/button, model accuracy or electrical acceptance claimed.
